layout.title: Hi, I'm Shuzhao Feng
layout.description: Personal website of Shuzhao Feng, master's student in Electrical and Computer Engineering at McGill University.
main.intro: I'm currently pursuing a master's degree in Electrical and Computer Engineering at McGill University. My main interest lies in large generative models, with a particular focus on making software creation accessible to everyone, regardless of technical background. To this end, I am working on enhancing the code generation abilities of large language models. Looking ahead, I hope to explore the multimodal capabilities of these models to further expand what people can build with AI.
